classification.difficultyReason: Combines subtraction from a right angle with subtraction from a revolution.

content.prompt:
Find $\angle AOC$ in the diagram to the right.

Also give the size of reflex angle $\angle AOC$.

spec.description: OA points right, OB points up and OC lies between them. The right-angle square marks BOA; 32 degrees lies between OB and OC. Decorative source blue is rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: OA is perpendicular to OB; angle BOC is 32 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 32-degree angle and right-angle marker are visible.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOC+32^\circ&=90^\circ\\\angle AOC&=90^\circ-32^\circ\\\angle AOC&=58^\circ\end{align*}$$
Adjacent angles forming the right angle $BOA$ add to $90^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Reflex }\angle AOC&=360^\circ-58^\circ\\\text{Reflex }\angle AOC&=302^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in a revolution at $O$ add to $360^\circ$.
